source: Malik (1990) JCP 86:376 Table V, Case 4 (M=10, R=2000, T_w/T_adb=0.1 cooled, alpha=0.105, beta=0). Dimensional conditions (T0=4200 degR, cooled wall) read from Malik Table I (refPapers/NewPapers/figures/malik1990_table1_test_cases.png); eigenvalue from Table V (4CD, N+1=81).
quantity: temporal frequency eigenvalue omega = omega_r + i*omega_i at fixed real alpha
verdict_reason: Hypersonic cooled-wall TEMPORAL second mode. pyMack omega=0.0974572+0.0019877i vs Malik 0.0974837+0.0020304i: omega_r rel err 2.72e-04 (0.027%, essentially exact), omega_i rel err 2.10e-02 (2.10%). The omega_i offset is well inside Malik's OWN Table V inter-scheme spread for this deliberately severe M=10 case (2FD/4CD/SDSP/MDSP span omega_r=0.097400..0.097486, omega_i=0.0020224..0.0020316 at N+1=61; pyMack's omega_r lands squarely inside that band). Previously logged non-reproducible for lack of the dimensional conditions (Hildebrand lists only M and Re); adding the source paper (Table I: T0=4200 degR, cooled wall) unlocked it. Mirror of validation/test_malik1990_case4_anchor.py.
